reasoning: The target package jsonwebtoken version 0.1.0 is pulled in as a transitive dependency by express-jwt@0.1.3, which constrains jsonwebtoken to ~0.1.0. Even though jsonwebtoken 0.4.0 is declared as a direct dependency in package.json, npm nests jsonwebtoken 0.1.0 under node_modules/express-jwt/node_modules/jsonwebtoken. Upgrading the direct dependency alone will not remediate the transitive vulnerability. To enforce a secure version (9.0.0) across all transitive dependents without breaking package resolution or requiring a major rewrite of express-jwt, a transitive override must be declared in package.json.
